correctness.rationale: The star is feasible. On the compact budget simplex eigenvalues are bounded above and approach to disconnection sends a restricted eigenvalue to zero, so sublevels of either objective avoid disconnection. Scaling to spend the budget strictly improves any underspend. Restriction to 1⊥ preserves injectivity of the edge-weight-to-Laplacian map; trace Hessian coefficients are strictly positive, including at eigenvalue collisions. Thus uniqueness among unrestricted independent edge weights forces the two orbit weights a,b. Pair differences, differences of pair means, and the hub-versus-periphery mode give a+2b (m), a (m−1), and (2m+1)a (1), respectively. With c=4γ−1, s=1+2b/a and U=m−1+(2m+1)^(−p), differentiating at p>0 reduces to the sign of U−mc s^(−p−1), even if c≤0. At p=0 the log expression reduces to the sign of s−c. This gives the boundary and exact formulas, including b=0 at threshold equality. At the strictly intermediate prices the activation equation U=mc has a unique p_c. On the active interval h=log(mc/U) is increasing and strictly concave; the derivative sign of log s is that of (p+1)h′−h, which strictly decreases from positive to a negative limit. Thus the spending fraction, an increasing function of s, has one strict global peak and tends to zero with b/a asymptotic to log(mc/(m−1))/(2p). No disappearance at a second finite order or uniqueness for the separate spectral-gap endpoint is implied. The packaged checker was inspected, not executed; finite diagnostics cannot prove unrestricted optimality.

originality.rationale: The determinant and inverse-first-moment slices are already covered. A same-day triangular-book theorem proves the same qualitative activation, peak and asymptotic withdrawal pattern for its two-page book and uses the same scalar mechanism. The surviving distinct result is the exact priced friendship-family law for every m≥2 and all real orders, including the one-peak window for every such m, not priority for the generic peak method or phenomenon.
residual_risks: No priority is inferred from the same-date triangular-book and bipartite records. The two-page-book peak is material conceptual overlap, not credited as an original generic phenomenon here.

value.rationale: For a natural network family the result gives a complete tractable design law under unrestricted edge allocation, which reveals a finite-order activation and exactly one maximum followed by withdrawal at every family size in the explicit price window. Even knowing boundary criterion designs, or the effect on the two-page book, does not determine this family's nonmonotone investment size. The exact cutoffs and finite-order versus limiting distinction are useful beyond re-evaluating the known p=0 and p=1 designs.
